title: telemetry
description: Periodic snapshot of one collector node. A sensor that is missing or failed reports null, never a fake 0.

buffered.description: True when the message was stored while offline and is being replayed. Omitted means false.

hv_on.description: High voltage actually enabled by the safety core (M3).

hv_level.description: Commanded HV level: 0 = off, 1 = module maximum.

fog_idx_opt.description: Fog index from the optical sensor: 0 = clear air, 1 = densest fog seen in calibration.

fog_idx_virt.description: Fog index estimated from the corona current (M5b virtual sensor). Null while HV is off.

mass_g.description: Water on the collector since the last TARE (load cell).

p_w.description: Electrical power drawn by the HV module.

e_wh.description: HV energy used since boot. With mass_g this gives grams per watt-hour. Null when no power sensor is installed.

arc_risk.description: Latest arc probability from the arc predictor (M5a). Null when the model is not running.

arc_novel.description: Optional (1.3). Share of the arc predictor's last 50 windows (5 s) unlike its training data (M5a novelty guard: clipped input, current out of the trained range, unusual shape). High: arc_risk is less trustworthy, the controller (M6) stops climbing. Absent or null while the HV is off.

health.description: Electrode health from the Townsend fit I = K·V·(V − V0) (M5c).

onset_level.description: Estimated corona onset V0, in hv_level units. Rising onset means fouling or wear.

k_coef.description: Estimated Townsend coefficient K, in µA per hv_level squared.

score.description: 1 = like new, 0 = needs cleaning or replacement.

radar_presence.description: Radar sees a person within the safety distance.Null when no radar is installed.

lid_closed.description: Enclosure lid switch. Null when no lid switch is installed.

batt_pct.description: Battery charge. Null when the node runs on bench power.
